body:
Android users currently need the separate touch preview for phone layouts. This adds **Settings > Appearance > Interface mode (TV / Mobile)** to the standard APK, so one installation supports phones, tablets and TVs with the same account, settings and library.

TV remains the default with its remote-oriented 1920×1080 canvas. Mobile enables touch layouts, direct scrolling, portrait/landscape browsing, native keyboard input and an aspect-preserving canvas. Full-screen playback uses landscape. Switching modes updates the existing renderer and Android window without restarting the Activity.

The choice is saved only on this device; account sync and profile changes cannot replace it. Mobile also works when explicitly selected on 16:9 and 16:10 devices. The production application ID, release signing and normal updater behavior are preserved.

This is based on upstream 2.0.4 (`db6ae4ee`). The PR contains application code, localized settings, mode documentation and production Android packaging support. Added tests, fixtures, capture hooks, review workflows and preview-package build options have been removed from this PR. Existing upstream tests and CI are unchanged. The complete reviewed version is retained on the [validation branch](https://github.com/ghbarker/nuvio-native-legacy/tree/review/android-tv-mobile-validation).

Validation:

- [Earlier full review](https://github.com/ghbarker/nuvio-native-legacy/actions/runs/38096421875): all 57 regression checks, three APK builds, Android policy tests and Android 36/16 KB emulator smoke passed. [All 21 rendered UI groups and both native negative controls passed](https://github.com/ghbarker/nuvio-native-legacy/actions/runs/38096421862).
- [Cleaned production APK build](https://github.com/ghbarker/nuvio-native-legacy/actions/runs/38098967069): passed for the standard APK and a compatible test APK, with both ARM architectures, verified package IDs/labels and 16 KB native packaging checks.
- also tested live playback and device switching. 

[Test APK download](https://github.com/ghbarker/nuvio-native-legacy/actions/runs/38098967069/artifacts/11686388313): extract the ZIP and install the APK labeled **Nuvio TV/Mobile Test**. It uses the existing Touch preview package ID and debug signing key for update compatibility. This test installation configuration lives only on the review branch.

[Interface mode documentation](https://github.com/ghbarker/nuvio-native-legacy/blob/7437d8721a9ad936a5f88ef50e668e2d860b2832/docs/android/INTERFACE-MODES.md) explains the behavior.
title: Android: switch between TV and Mobile in one APK
